items.stem: 다음 중 단어와 뜻이 <u>잘못</u> 연결된 것은?
items.explain: express는 '표현하다'. '전시하다'는 exhibit.

items.box: Junho: Look at this exhibition poster. What do you think about this painting? Minji: I think it's beautiful. Alex: It's The Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh, right? Junho: Right. I like this painting. The colors of the night sky are amazing. Alex: ____________________ Junho: Look! The van Gogh exhibition is going on at Mirae Museum. How about going there together? Alex: That's a great idea! I want to see van Gogh's paintings. Minji: We can also learn about his life and art in the exhibition. Junho: When can we go? It ends on October 1st. Alex: Let's go there this Saturday then. Minji: That sounds great.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: The three friends are looking at a poster of Sunflowers.
The van Gogh exhibition ends on October 1st.
They will go to the museum this Sunday.
Minji thinks the exhibition is boring.
items.explain: It ends on October 1st. / 포스터는 「별이 빛나는 밤」, Junho는 그림을 좋아하고, 토요일에 가며, Minji는 That sounds great.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 밤하늘의 색이 놀랍다는 Junho의 의견에 동의 → I think so, too.

items.stem: 다음 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 말은?
items.box:
• Please stop this ______.
• What does this word ______?
• Her face didn't show any ______.
• I usually take a ______ after lunch.
items.explain: battle / mean / emotion / nap 순서. shape(모양)는 들어갈 자리가 없다.

items.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 나머지 4개와 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: She is <u>drawing</u> cartoons in her room.
They are <u>collecting</u> shells on the beach.
A fisherman is <u>catching</u> fish in the sea.
items.explain: ①은 주어 His hobby를 설명하는 보어 역할의 동명사. 나머지는 「be동사+-ing」 현재진행형의 현재분사.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Grammar Points 2(cf.) · 선생님 제작

items.stem: 다음 중 문법적으로 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
• Watching movies are fun.
• I hope that you will feel better soon.
• My job is to teach little children.
• Thank you for inviting me.
• Angela will learn to bake a cake.
items.explain: 옳은 것: I hope that ~ / My job is to teach ~ / Thank you for inviting me / will learn to bake (4개). 동명사 주어는 단수 취급 → Watching movies is fun.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Grammar Points 2 · L6 Grammar Points 1·2

items.stem: 다음 대화문을 읽고 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 고르시오.
items.box:
B: What do you think about this painting, Sora?
G: I think it's interesting. What about you?
B: Well, ____________________ I think this painting is scary.
items.explain: '흥미롭다'는 의견 뒤에 '이 그림은 무섭다'고 반대 의견을 말하므로 Well, I don't think so.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 나머지 4개와 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: I can't believe <u>that</u> she is forty years old.
She heard <u>that</u> they bought a new car.
The important thing is <u>that</u> you did your best.
<u>That</u> he told a lie is true.
items.explain: ③의 that은 '저것'을 뜻하는 지시대명사. 나머지는 명사절을 이끄는 접속사(①② 목적어, ④ 보어, ⑤ 주어).

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 알맞게 짝지은 것은?
items.box:
• There was a (A)______ statue of Admiral Yi.
• He (B)______ his own style and finally became famous.
items.explain: a huge statue of Admiral Yi(거대한 동상) / kept his own style(자신의 스타일을 지켰다).

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은?

box.title: My Weekend
lines: Hi! I'm Jinho. Let me tell you about my weekend. ⓐ<u>There are many parks near my house.</u> ⓑ<u>I enjoy riding a bike in the park with my sister.</u> ⓒ<u>Riding a bike is really fun.</u> ⓓ<u>I know that she likes it, too.</u> ⓔ<u>We hope going there again next weekend.</u>

items.explain: hope는 to부정사를 목적어로 쓴다 → We hope to go there again. ⓐ are+복수, ⓑ enjoy+동명사, ⓒ 동명사 주어+단수 동사, ⓓ 접속사 that은 옳다.
items.source: 선생님 제작(there is/are · 동명사 · that · to부정사)

items.box:
Alex: Hi, Kate. What are you going to do this weekend?
Kate: I'm going to visit Jeju-do with my family.
Junho: Oh, my grandparents live <u>there</u>. Jeju-do is so beautiful.
Kate: Really? This is my first trip to Jeju-do. I'm so excited.
Alex: ____________________
Kate: I'm going to see dolphins. I'll also hike Hallasan.
Junho: You should visit a horse park and ride a horse, too. It's really fun.
Kate: That's a good idea. I'll visit there, too.
Junho: Jeju-do is an amazing place. Have a nice trip!

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 there가 가리키는 것은?
items.explain: Kate가 제주도에 간다는 말에 '조부모님이 거기(제주도) 사셔'.

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: What are you going to do there?
What do you think about it?
items.explain: 답이 '돌고래를 보고 한라산을 하이킹할 것'이므로 거기서 무엇을 할 것인지 묻는 말.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?
choices: Kate는 승마 공원에는 가지 않겠다고 했다.
items.explain: That's a good idea. I'll visit there, too. → 승마 공원에도 가겠다고 했다.

box.title: Garam's Travel Diary
lines: Early in the morning, we went to Dongpirang. There were many pretty paintings on the walls. [A] It was the best place for taking pictures! Mom and I took hundreds of pictures. [B] Finally, my dad said, "Please stop! No more pictures!" 'Dong' means 'east,' and 'pirang' means 'cliff.' [C] Next, we went to the Jeon Hyuck-lim Museum of Art. [D] The painter's nickname is 'The Magician of Color.' He painted the sea of Tongyeong with various blue colors. [E] I enjoyed his paintings very much. What a great experience! Going on a family trip is always fun. Tongyeong, bye for now! See you next time!

items.stem: 윗글에서 <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 <u>적절한</u> 곳은?
items.explain: '동'은 '동쪽', '피랑'은 '절벽'이라는 설명 뒤에 '서피랑도 있다'가 자연스럽다.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
items.explain: 'Dong' means 'east.' / 아침 일찍, 엄마와 가람이가 찍음, 전혁림 미술관에 갔고, 그림을 매우 즐겼다.

items.stem: 윗글의 제목으로 가장 자연스러운 것은?
choices: A Day of Pictures and Paintings in Tongyeong
items.explain: 동피랑에서 사진을 찍고 전혁림 미술관에서 그림을 본 통영 여행 둘째 날 일기.

items.box: Hi, there. Can you find me in the picture? Actually, I'm an animal. Start from the green shape in the middle. Then trace the other shapes with your finger. [A]<u>They</u> look like a snail shell. Yes, I'm a snail! Matisse created me in a unique way. He painted paper and cut out shapes with scissors. Then he put the shapes together and made me. At the age of 70, Matisse got very sick. ______, he never gave up art. He created a new art form. It's cut-outs. Do you want to find more artworks like me? Look around the gallery and explore Henri Matisse's world of art!

items.stem: 윗글에서 밑줄 친 [A]가 가리키는 것은?
items.explain: 앞 문장의 the green shape과 the other shapes, 즉 모양들이 달팽이 껍데기처럼 보인다.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 자연스러운 것은?
items.explain: 매우 아팠다 ↔ 그러나 예술을 포기하지 않았다. 역접의 However.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?
choices: 마티스는 종이를 칠하고 가위로 모양을 오려 냈다.
종이 오리기(cut-outs)는 마티스의 새로운 예술 형태이다.
items.explain: However, he never gave up art. → 결코 포기하지 않았다.

box.title: Garam's Travel Diary
lines: ⓐ<u>I got up at six in the morning.</u> It was the first day of my family trip to Tongyeong. I was excited! We arrived at Jungang Market at 1 p.m. There we had Chungmu gimbap for lunch. ⓑ<u>There was only rice inside the roll!</u> Dad said, "Try the roll with radish and squid. Long ago, fishermen had Chungmu gimbap out at sea." It was a bit spicy but tasty. Chungmu is Tongyeong's old name. In the afternoon, we went to Yi Sun-sin Park. ⓒ<u>There were a huge statue of Admiral Yi.</u> I imagined the great battle right off the coast of Tongyeong. Then ⓓ<u>we enjoyed taking a walk</u> along the coast. The sunset was beautiful. I closed my eyes. ⓔ<u>I could feel</u> Admiral Yi's love for the country. Everything was really peaceful.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은?
items.explain: a huge statue는 단수 → There was a huge statue of Admiral Yi. ⓑ rice(셀 수 없는 명사)+was, ⓓ enjoy+동명사는 옳다.

items.stem: <보기>의 (A)~(D)를 윗글의 흐름에 맞게 순서대로 배열한 것은?

box.title: <보 기>
lines: (A) Garam's family had Chungmu gimbap for lunch.
(B) Garam got up at six in the morning.
(D) Garam's family went to Yi Sun-sin Park.

items.explain: 아침 6시 기상 → 점심 충무김밥 → 오후 이순신 공원 → 해안 산책 중 일몰.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Garam's family arrived at Jungang Market in the morning.
Chungmu gimbap had radish inside the roll.
Garam took a walk along the river.
Garam felt nervous in the evening.
items.explain: Chungmu is Tongyeong's old name. / 오후 1시 도착, 롤 안에는 밥만, 해안(coast)을 따라 산책, 평화로움을 느낌.

items.box: Hello, everyone. My name is Amélie. Welcome to my husband's gallery. Look at me. Do you think that I'm strange? My husband, Henri Matisse, ⓐcolored my face in green. Don't worry. My face isn't ⓑactually green. Why did he paint me this way then? He wanted to ⓒexpress his emotions with bright and wild colors. People didn't like this painting style ______. Some people thought that a beast painted me. So, he got the nickname Wild Beast. He ⓓkept his own style and ⓔfinally became famous.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 자연스러운 것은?
items.explain: 처음에는 좋아하지 않았지만 결국 유명해졌다는 흐름 → at first(처음에는).

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에서 우리말 뜻이 알맞지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
items.explain: kept는 '지켰다, 유지했다'(keep의 과거). '잘라냈다'는 cut out.

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 <u>없는</u> 질문은?
choices: What color did Matisse use for Amélie's face?
Why did Matisse paint Amélie this way?
How much did Matisse sell the painting for?
items.explain: 그림의 판매 가격은 나오지 않는다. (앙리 마티스 / 초록색 / 감정을 표현하려고 / Wild Beast)
